record.paper_title: Open problems in PDE models for knowledge-based animal movement via nonlocal perception and cognitive mapping
record.context_brief: Existence for delay models with added nonlocal perception
record.original_question: For either the scalar discrete-delay model with advective term based on u_τ or the delayed consumer-resource system with advective term based on v_τ, in what sense do solutions exist when one augments the delay mechanism by nonlocal perception through a top-hat detection function?

evidence.quote: Open Problem 28. In what sense do solutions exist to solve problems of form (2.20) or (2.24) when a nonlocal perception through a top-hat detection function is included in addition to an explicit time delay?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Consider the following two reaction–diffusion–advection models on a bounded domain $\Omega \subset \mathbb{R}^n$ with smooth boundary, subject to no-flux (homogeneous Neumann) boundary conditions and prescribed initial data on $[-\tau,0]$.

(A) Scalar discrete-delay model. For $u=u(x,t)\ge 0$,
$$u_t = D\Delta u - \nabla\cdot\bigl(\alpha\, u\, \nabla(K_\sigma * u_\tau)\bigr) + f(u,u_\tau),$$
where $\tau>0$ is a fixed time delay, $u_\tau(x,t):=u(x,t-\tau)$, $D,\alpha>0$, $f$ is a smooth reaction term (e.g.\ logistic growth), and the perception kernel is the top-hat detection function
$$K_\sigma(x) = \frac{1}{|B_\sigma(0)\cap\Omega|}\,\mathbf{1}_{B_\sigma(0)}(x),$$
with $\sigma>0$ the perceptual radius, and the convolution understood in the spatial variable.

(B) Delayed consumer–resource system. For consumer $u(x,t)\ge 0$ and resource $v(x,t)\ge 0$,
$$\begin{cases} u_t = D_u\Delta u - \nabla\cdot\bigl(\alpha\, u\, \nabla(K_\sigma * v_\tau)\bigr) + F(u,v),\\ v_t = D_v\Delta v + G(u,v),\end{cases}$$
where $v_\tau(x,t)=v(x,t-\tau)$, $D_u,D_v,\alpha>0$, and $F,G$ are smooth kinetic terms encoding consumer–resource interaction; the kernel $K_\sigma$ is the top-hat function above.

Question. In what functional/solution sense (e.g.\ classical, strong, weak, or mild solutions) does there exist a (local or global) solution to each of the systems (A) and (B), given suitable nonnegative initial histories $u_0\in C([-\tau,0];X)$ (resp.\ $(u_0,v_0)$) in an appropriate function space $X$ on $\Omega$? Establish existence (and, if possible, uniqueness, nonnegativity, and global-in-time extension) of solutions when the advective velocity is generated by the nonlocal top-hat perception of the delayed density, combining both an explicit time delay $\tau$ and a nonlocal spatial perception of radius $\sigma$.
artifact.status_search_result: Recent works address pattern formation and bifurcation for delayed nonlocal models with top-hat kernels (e.g., a 2025 Bulletin of Mathematical Biology paper on a delayed pine-wilt model, and stability/bifurcation studies for predator–prey systems with top-hat kernels), and global existence results have been obtained for nonlocal advection–diffusion models without delay. However, no source directly establishes a general existence theory for the combined delay + top-hat nonlocal advection scalar and consumer–resource systems posed here, so the question appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: Pattern Formation Driven by Nonlocal Perception in a Delayed Pine Wilt Disease Model with Top-Hat Kernel
status_evidence.snippet: Studies a delayed reaction–diffusion model with top-hat nonlocal perception focusing on pattern formation/bifurcation rather than a general existence theorem.
status_evidence.claim: Related delay + top-hat models have been analyzed for bifurcation but not for general well-posedness.

status_evidence.title: Positivity and global existence for nonlocal advection-diffusion models of interacting populations
status_evidence.snippet: Proves global existence of weak/classical solutions for nonlocal advection–diffusion systems, generalizing prior existence results, but without explicit time delay.
status_evidence.claim: Existence theory exists for nonlocal advection–diffusion without delay; the delayed case remains to be settled.

status_evidence.title: Open problems in PDE models for knowledge-based animal movement via nonlocal perception and cognitive mapping
status_evidence.snippet: Lists open problems concerning existence of solutions when nonlocal top-hat perception is combined with explicit delay.
status_evidence.claim: The combined delay + top-hat existence question is listed as an open problem.
